summary: Master Microsoft Excel for effective project management. Enroll in our course to learn key strategies and tools to elevate your project success.
lede: Excel project management training helps project managers and analysts connect schedule, cost, resource, risk, and status data in controlled workbooks. Participants structure work breakdowns, calculate dependencies and critical paths, track baseline variance and earned value, and consolidate updates into dashboards with validation and refresh controls.
audienceIntro: This Excel project management course is designed for professionals who create, maintain, review, or rely on spreadsheet-based project controls. It suits experienced Excel users who need to connect scheduling, budgeting, resource, risk, and reporting responsibilities.
modules: Excel Project Management Data with Power Query
Excel Project Management Schedules and Gantt Controls
Excel Critical Path and Forecast Analysis
Excel Cost and Earned Value Controls
prerequisites: You should have working experience with Microsoft Excel formulas, cell references, sorting, filtering, and basic charts. Familiarity with project schedules, budgets, risks, or status reports will help you apply the exercises, although prior use of specialist scheduling software is unnecessary. You need a laptop with a current desktop edition of Microsoft Excel that supports Power Query, PivotTables, and the Solver add-in. Coding or programming is not required. The course begins at intermediate spreadsheet level and progresses to advanced operational application of project controls, while AI-assisted features remain optional and depend on your Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
